summary: The Charles Schwab Corporation filed an 8-K to report the issuance and sale of 1,500,000 depositary shares representing Series L preferred stock, raising approximately $1,480 million in net proceeds. The filing includes a Certificate of Designations establishing terms of the preferred stock, with restrictions on dividends and repurchases if preferred dividends are unpaid. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is involved. The filing solely concerns a preferred stock issuance and amendments to articles of incorporation related to the new series.
